```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(caret)
library(car)
library(glmnet)
library(ggplot2)
library(corrplot)
library(readxl)
library(car)

```


# Data Loading


```{r}
dataset <- read_excel("Dataset.xlsx")
summary(dataset)
```




# Data Preprocessing



```{r}
# Select predictors including age, player value, and wages along with other key attributes
dataset <- dataset %>%
  dplyr::select(overall, pace, shooting, passing, dribbling, defending, physic, 
                weak_foot, skill_moves, age, value_eur, wage_eur)

# Check for missing values
missing_counts <- colSums(is.na(dataset))
print(missing_counts)

# Remove rows with any missing values
dataset <- dataset %>% drop_na()

```


# Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)

```{r}
# Correlation matrix
cor_matrix <- cor(dataset, use = "complete.obs")
corrplot::corrplot(cor_matrix, method = "circle")

```


# Multiple Linear Regression


```{r}
# Multiple Linear Regression Model
model_lm <- lm(overall ~ pace + shooting + passing + dribbling + defending + physic + 
               weak_foot + skill_moves + age + value_eur + wage_eur, data = dataset)

# Summary and metrics
summary(model_lm)


```

```{r}
# Calculate predictions
predictions <- predict(model_lm, dataset)

# Calculate MSE
mse <- mean((dataset$overall - predictions)^2)
cat("Mean Squared Error (MSE):", mse, "\n")

```

# Polynomial Regression Setup


```{r}
# Add Polynomial Terms for Key Predictors
dataset$pace2 <- dataset$pace^2
dataset$shooting2 <- dataset$shooting^2
dataset$passing2 <- dataset$passing^2
dataset$dribbling2 <- dataset$dribbling^2
dataset$defending2 <- dataset$defending^2
dataset$physic2 <- dataset$physic^2

# Polynomial Regression Model
model_poly <- lm(overall ~ pace + pace2 + shooting + shooting2 + passing + passing2 + 
                 dribbling + dribbling2 + defending + defending2 + physic + physic2 + 
                 weak_foot + skill_moves + age + value_eur + wage_eur, data = dataset)

# Display Summary for Polynomial Regression Model
summary(model_poly)



```




```{r}
# Calculate MSE for Polynomial Regression Model
predictions_poly <- predict(model_poly, newdata = dataset)
mse_poly <- mean((dataset$overall - predictions_poly)^2)
cat("Mean Squared Error (MSE) for Polynomial Regression:", mse_poly, "\n")
```


# External validation


```{r}
# Split dataset into training and testing sets
set.seed(123)  # For reproducibility
train_index <- sample(seq_len(nrow(dataset)), size = 0.8 * nrow(dataset))
train_data <- dataset[train_index, ]
test_data <- dataset[-train_index, ]

# Train Polynomial Regression model on the training data
model_poly_train <- lm(overall ~ pace + I(pace^2) + shooting + I(shooting^2) + 
                         passing + I(passing^2) + dribbling + I(dribbling^2) + 
                         defending + I(defending^2) + physic + I(physic^2) + 
                         weak_foot + skill_moves + age + value_eur + wage_eur, 
                         data = train_data)

# Predict on the test set
predictions_test <- predict(model_poly_train, newdata = test_data)

# Calculate MSE and R-squared on the test set
mse_test <- mean((test_data$overall - predictions_test)^2)
r_squared_test <- 1 - (sum((test_data$overall - predictions_test)^2) / sum((test_data$overall - mean(test_data$overall))^2))
cat("External Validation - Test MSE:", mse_test, "\n")
cat("External Validation - Test R-squared:", r_squared_test, "\n")

```



# Residual Analysis

```{r}
# Residuals vs Fitted
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
plot(model_poly_train, which = 1)

# Normal Q-Q plot
plot(model_poly_train, which = 2)

# Scale-Location plot
plot(model_poly_train, which = 3)

# Residuals vs Leverage plot
plot(model_poly_train, which = 5)

```

# Multicollinearity Analysis

```{r}
# Center key predictors
dataset <- dataset %>%
  mutate(
    pace = scale(pace, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE),
    shooting = scale(shooting, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE),
    passing = scale(passing, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE),
    dribbling = scale(dribbling, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE),
    defending = scale(defending, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE),
    physic = scale(physic, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)
  )

# Recalculate polynomial terms
dataset <- dataset %>%
  mutate(
    pace2 = pace^2,
    shooting2 = shooting^2,
    passing2 = passing^2,
    dribbling2 = dribbling^2,
    defending2 = defending^2,
    physic2 = physic^2
  )

# Fit polynomial regression model with centered terms
model_poly_centered <- lm(overall ~ pace + pace2 + shooting + shooting2 + passing + passing2 + 
                            dribbling + dribbling2 + defending + defending2 + physic + physic2 + 
                            weak_foot + skill_moves + age + value_eur + wage_eur, data = dataset)

# Calculate VIFs again
vif_poly_centered <- vif(model_poly_centered)
print(vif_poly_centered)

```
